title: moeb use command should support specifying agent, workflow, and task
description: moeb use currently selects an AI adapter but does not allow specifying which agent persona, workflow variant, or task type to apply for a given invocation. When multiple agent roles (architect, reviewer, coder) or workflow variants (run with QA only, run with full review) are available, there is no way to select them without editing the skill file or config.
proposed_resolution: Extend moeb use to accept --agent, --workflow, and --task flags in addition to the adapter name. These map to named configurations in the skill file (agent_roles, workflow_variants, task_types sections). The selection is applied at invocation time and may be combined (e.g. moeb use anthropic --agent architect --task spec). Update the skill runner to resolve the combined selection and document the flag conventions in moeb help.
